skill.name: analyzing-products
skill.description: Normalizes a product into generation-ready facts — from an e-commerce URL (a clean description plus curated product images) or from a photo alone (category, how it's used, its moving/opening parts, and key visual details). Use when a product URL or photo needs turning into inputs for image/video generation, or when another skill needs product facts before generating.
skill.author: supercmohq
skill.summary: Turns product URLs and photos into factual briefs for image and video generation.

security_audit.summary: All eight static findings are false positives. The matched text is product-analysis prose, Markdown references, or a curl example without a literal hardcoded IP. A separate medium-risk finding remains because the URL workflow downloads extractor-supplied URLs without documented host restrictions.

remediation.issue: The URL workflow downloads up to ten extractor-supplied image URLs without documented host or private-network restrictions.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTPS and approved public hosts, reject loopback and private address ranges after DNS resolution, disable unsafe redirects, and enforce response size and timeout limits.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted URL Fetching May Enable SSRF
semantic_findings.description: The URL workflow downloads up to ten image URLs returned by extraction with curl, without documented host allowlisting or private-network rejection. A crafted page or input could direct requests to internal services or unintended endpoints.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented download step clearly accepts extractor-supplied URLs and follows redirects by using curl -L. The files do not document validation against loopback, private, or otherwise untrusted destinations.

content.value_statement: Product pages and photos often contain scattered details that lead to inaccurate creative outputs. This skill extracts consistent product facts, usage mechanics, visual details, and reference images for downstream generation.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes an e-commerce URL and extracts product name, brand, price, variant, specifications, and feature details.
Downloads up to ten candidate product images and keeps up to five clean, matching product shots.
Filters candidate images for product focus, visible faces, and variant mismatches.
Analyzes a product photo for category, real-world use, moving parts, opening steps, and visual details.
Produces factual descriptions and reusable product facts for image and video generation workflows.
limitations: It cannot reliably determine unclear, cropped, blurry, or ambiguous product details.
URL extraction depends on the configured url_extraction capability and accessible product pages.
Image filtering may reject useful lifestyle images because it prioritizes clean product shots.
It does not rank market position or replace a calling skill's creative direction.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Creative
use_cases.description: Turn a product page into a factual brief and selected reference images before creating campaign images or videos.

use_cases.title: Document Product Mechanics
use_cases.description: Analyze a product photo to capture how people hold, operate, open, or use the product in generated scenes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Catalog Inputs
use_cases.description: Convert inconsistent product links and photos into reusable facts for a team library or downstream generation pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Product Photo
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this product photo. State what the product is, how people use it, which parts move or open, and its key visual details.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Product Page Facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the product name, brand, price, currency, selected variant, description, specifications, features, and main product photo URLs from this page.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Generation Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this product URL and return a factual two-paragraph description, concrete specifications, intended user, and up to five clean matching product images.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Product Fidelity
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the provided product URL and image together. Reconcile the listing with the photo, identify the selected variant, describe all operating mechanics, and flag any uncertain detail instead of guessing.

output_examples.input: Analyze this photo of a countertop coffee grinder.
output_examples.output: A compact electric burr coffee grinder with a matte black cylindrical body, a transparent bean hopper, a front grind-size dial, and a removable grounds container. The hopper lid lifts off, and the container slides forward for emptying.

output_examples.input: Extract the product facts from this insulated bottle page.
output: Stainless steel insulated bottle with a 750 ml capacity, screw-top lid, powder-coated finish, and leak-resistant seal.
Keep the front product shot and the open-lid detail image. Exclude lifestyle photos, logos, and unrelated color variants.

output_examples.input: Prepare this skincare product for an image-generation workflow.
output_examples.output: Product brief: frosted glass dropper bottle with an ivory label, black cap, and clear serum. Preserve the rectangular label placement, short shoulder, glossy pipette, and warm off-white packaging color. The cap unscrews before the dropper is used.

best_practices: Provide the product URL or a clear, well-framed product photo.
State the intended image or video generation context when requesting analysis.
Review uncertain specifications and downloaded images before publishing generated creative.
anti_patterns: Do not use a blurry or cropped photo as the only source for precise product mechanics.
Do not treat extracted product claims as verified technical or safety certification.
Do not reuse downloaded images without checking licensing and source permissions.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill accept?
faq.answer: It accepts an e-commerce URL, a product photo, or both.

faq.question: What does URL mode return?
faq.answer: It returns factual product details, a concise description, and up to five filtered product image paths.

faq.question: What does photo mode identify?
faq.answer: It identifies the product category, real-world use, moving or opening parts, and important visual details.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple product variants?
faq.answer: It focuses on the selected listing variant and removes candidate images that show a different variant.

faq.question: What happens when a product page cannot be extracted?
faq.answer: The workflow asks for a product photo and switches to photo analysis.

faq.question: Does it create new product images?
faq.answer: No. It prepares facts and selects reference images for another image or video generation skill.
